facts.business: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited is a retail jewellery company operating in Tamil Nadu, India, selling gold, silver, and diamond jewellery through its own retail outlets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Opening of 10 new retail outlets in FY 25-26
Phase II expansion - 9 outlets in Chennai Metro by 31/12/2026
Capital expenditure for 6 new retail stores including one flagship store in Chennai Metropolitan Area (from rights issue proceeds)
Inventory for new stores (from rights issue proceeds)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Chennai Division to contribute 25% of total revenue on annualized basis
Complete Phase II expansion of 9 outlets in Chennai Metro
Funding rationale of 1/3 equity, 1/3 customer advances, 1/3 bank borrowings to be maintained

key_risks: Fluctuations in gold and silver prices affecting affordability and demand
Geo-political uncertainties (e.g., Iran war) impacting jewellery trade
Funding requirements for hedged inventory due to margin and MTM calls
Uneven offtake in marketplace due to price uncertainties
Regulatory changes such as New Labour Codes increasing employee benefit costs
facts.related_party_note: The three Joint Managing Directors (Balarama Govinda Das, Ba.Ramesh, N.B.Kumar) are brothers and promoter directors. Each received remuneration of Rs.144 lakhs in FY 25-26.
